FOPE 500.title: Sustainable Forest Management in a Changing World
FOPE 500.description: Origins of sustainable forest management; criteria and indicators of sustainable forest management used globally and how these will need to be adapted to our changing climate.

FOPE 501.title: Geomatics in Forestry: Data Collection and Management
FOPE 501.description: Fundamental concepts of spatial technologies and geo-spatial analysis.

FOPE 502.title: Introduction to Urban Forestry in the Asian Pacific Region
FOPE 502.description: Principles behind urban forest governance, urban forest planning and green-space management, and their role in human health and wellbeing in the Asia-Pacific Region.

FOPE 503.title: Climate Modelling and Forest Applications
FOPE 503.description: Potential impacts of climate change on global forest systems. Concepts and techniques of climate change modelling; adaptive management strategies.

FOPE 504.title: Structure and Composition of Tropical Forest Ecosystems
FOPE 504.description: Ecological characteristics of tropical forests including their structure and composition.

FOPE 505.title: Ecological Processes in Tropical Forests
FOPE 505.description: The ecological processes found in tropical humid and dry forests, including a series of case studies drawn from tropical forests around the world.

FOPE 507.title: International Forestry Issues, Institutions, and Multilateral Agreements
FOPE 507.description: Major contemporary global natural resources management issues emphasis on Forestry.

FOPE 508.title: Forest Ecosystem Services and Community Livelihoods
FOPE 508.description: Interdependence and dynamics of different forest ecosystem services and how they contribute to sustainable forest management and community livelihoods.

FOPE 509.title: Introduction to Intensive Plantation Forestry
FOPE 509.description: Case studies of plantation forestry systems from around the world; advantages and challenges of intensively managed forests.

FOPE 510.title: Plantation Silviculture
FOPE 510.description: Science of cultivating forest stands, including influence of climate and soil, characteristics of tree growth and stand development, and forest types and plantation designs.

FOPE 511.title: Wood Properties and Products
FOPE 511.description: Manufacturing processes, applications and supply chains of solid wood, composite, and engineered wood products; pulp and paper, bio-based materials and bioenergy.

FOPE 512.title: Forest Economics
FOPE 512.description: General and forestry-specific economic principles and concepts, including role of forests in sustainable development.

FOPE 513.title: Forest Finance
FOPE 513.description: Theoretical and technical skills to analyze corporate financial management in the forest industry, including analytical tools to analyze cost and benefit, evaluate risk, and identify optimum investment.

FOPE 514.title: Forest Business Enterprise
FOPE 514.description: Foundations of forest business enterprises (FBEs), including their role in forest management, interactions with stakeholders, and the drivers of successes and failures in FBEs.
